participation.context: Named last Saturday's 36s, refused a guess, and kept the glass struck.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Withheld tonight's share and any Rose sum he had not got.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Asked for a number, said Titus went without Will, and did not invent one on the road.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Kept the bill and the board as two truths, and waited on the glass.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

relations.note: he will not name an open bag

story.body: You let John keep the bag shut in speech. Titus was a bill you were not in. The Rose's fee was marked paid, with no sum. The glass stayed out of the room. You did not guess a share.

relations.note: he will not name an open bag

title: Left the bag open at the reckoning
